subject: Social Media
title: The Creator Economy Boom
description: A short lesson to help you apply The Creator Economy Boom.

hook.text: Fifty million people now call themselves creators. Two million do it full-time. It's the new middle class.

buildup.text: Platforms, tools, and monetization options exploded after 2020. Creating content became a real career.

discovery.text: The ecosystem includes Patreon, Substack, Gumroad, and platform funds. Creators have options beyond ads.

twist.text: Most creators earn almost nothing. The top 1% capture most revenue. It mirrors the income inequality it promised to fix.

climax.text: The creator middle class barely exists. You're either a star or you're subsidizing your content with a day job.

punchline.text: Everyone can create. Almost nobody can earn.

quiz.question: How many people create content full-time?
